notes:
New in 0.1.4.0 - sub-phase 1.4 (ground and erosion), part 1: smooth slopes
- The ground is now exact to the pixel. Before, the water only saw it as 2x2 pixel blocks, so every slope was a staircase that braked the water.
- Water slides along slopes and walls instead of catching on every step (free slip).
- Run-up now matches lab measurements much better: Normal within 13% (was 22-35% too low), Performance mode within 13% for normal waves (was 35-46% too low).
- Concrete is drawn per pixel: slopes look smooth.
- Concrete brush is at least 3 px wide (thinner walls could leak).
- Fixed: drawing thin concrete through water could break the water into a foam-like mesh.

Next in 1.4: ground types (sand, clay, rock), sea bed shapes, bed friction, erosion.
